gloss: stretch oneself out, lie down, lie stretched out
definition: רָבַץ verb stretch oneself out, lie down, lie stretched out (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Assyrian rabâƒu , lie, dwell ; rubƒu (in word-lists), stall , also womb (compare II. רבע above); Arabic lie down, on the breast, stretch oneself out , Sabean מרבצֿן CIS iv. no. 5, 2 ; ᵑ7 רְבַע lie stretched out , Syriac , Christian-Palestinian Aramaic recline at meals , Schw Idioticon 87 ); — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular ׳ ר Gen 49:9 , 3 feminine singular consecutive וְרָֽבְצָה Deut 29:19 , רָבָ֑צָה Ezek 19:2 , etc.; Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִרְבָּ֑ץ Isa 11:6 ; Isa 27:10 3 feminine singular וַתִּרְבַּץ Num 22:27 3 masculine plural יִרְבְּצוּ Num 11:7 יִרְבָּ֑צוּ Num 14:30 יִרְבָּצ֑וּן Zeph 2:7 ; Ps 104:22 3 feminine plural תִּרְבַּצְנָה Ezek 34:14 Participle רֹבֵץ Exod 23:5 + 3 t.; feminine רֹבֶ֫צֶת Gen 49:25 + 2 t.; masculine plural רֹבְצֹים Gen 29:2 — lie down, lie: of domestic animals, ass Exod 23:5 ( E ; under heavy burden), Num 22:27 (Jeremiah; in obstructed path), Gen 49:14 (at ease; poetic, in simile); sheep, in repose, Gen 29:2 ( J ), Isa 17:2 ; Zeph 2:14 figurative of people Ezek 34:14 calf. in repose Isa 27:10 : of wild beasts, lion, in lair, Gen 49:9 (poem in J ; figurative), Ps 104:22 = make lair, abode Ezek 19:2 (figurative), so of צִיִּים Isa 13:21 , תַּנֵין Ezek 29:3 (figurative); leopard (with kid) Isa 11:6 , compare v Isa 11:7 = brood, of mother-bird Deut 22:6 ( עַלהָֿאֶפְרֹחִים ); of man, in repose Isa 14:30 ; Job 11:19 , compare Zeph 2:7 ; Zeph 3:13 (figurative of flock perhaps implied, compare Ezek 34:14 above); of the deep, רֹבֶצֶת תָּ֑חַת Gen 49:25 ; Deut 33:13 figurative of curse Deut 29:19 ( ב person); of sin, לַפֶּתַח חַטָאת רֹבֵץ Gen 4:7 at the door sin makes its lair. Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine singular suffix יַרְבִּיצֵנִי Ps 23:2 , 2 masculine singular תַּרְבִּיץ Song 1:7 , etc.; Participle מַרְבִּיץ Isa 54:1 l, plural מַרְבִּצִים Jer 33:12 — cause to lie down , or lie , accusative of flock (for repose) Jer 33:12 , also (figurative) Ps 23:2 ; Ezek 34:15 accusative of flock omitted Isa 13:10 ; Song 1:7 of laying stones Isa 54:1 l.
